parts.normativeObligation: A pass requires that the number of sources which are independent, in-segment, document qualifying money or staff-hour commitment, and concern the existing problem is at least the configured minimum.
parts.sourceClauseReference: Pass requires the configured minimum of independent in-segment sources documenting qualifying money or staff-hour commitment to the existing problem.
parts.observableInvariant: Counting only sources satisfying all four qualifying predicates, the qualifying count is at least the configured minimum. A source failing any predicate is excluded from the count; its presence is never itself a violation.
parts.independenceJustification: One conjunctive pass criterion. The four qualifications determine which sources count toward the single threshold; they are predicates of this obligation, not independent obligations, because evaluating the raw count apart from them could report a satisfied minimum that no qualifying source supports.
knownLimitations: The four qualifications are exclusion predicates, not independent obligations. A non-qualifying source is excluded from the qualifying count and must not produce a violation when enough other sources qualify.
The single normative violation is that the qualifying count is below the configured minimum.
If the candidate-source inventory is incomplete, or any predicate classification is missing or untrusted, the result is indeterminate, never satisfied and never a violation.
Binds the configured threshold in checklist.json.
qualifyingPredicates: source is independent of the other counted sources
source documents qualifying money or staff-hour commitment
the commitment concerns the existing problem
